name: Haremence
source:
You are a young researcher at a uni lab often working long into the night on a device together with your colleague, Eva. The project's purpose was always to help people sort out their brain... But the day of the first test, you two realized the device makes them obey your will instead!
And just as you figured that out, powers that be did so too and are now after you! They kidnap your colleague and almost get you, but you manage to run away and go into hiding...

But you are not alone in that, and now you live with a group of scientist girls each of which has also invented something powerful...
translation:
你是大学实验室里的一名年轻研究员，常常与同事伊娃一起挑灯夜战，研发一台特殊装置。这个项目的初衷本是帮助人们理清大脑思绪……可在首次测试当天，你们俩惊讶地发现，这台装置竟然会让受试者对你的意志言听计从！
而就在你们意识到这一点的同时，幕后权贵也察觉到了风声，随即对你们展开追捕！他们绑走了你的同事，也差点抓到你，好在你侥幸逃脱并藏匿了起来……

不过在这场逃亡中你并非孤身一人——如今，你正与一群同样各自发明了某种强大造物的女科学家们同住在一个屋檐下……
